purpose: Extract the best engineering ideas from the Fallout 4 CBBE/BodySlide/BodyGen/physics ecosystem and mutate them into an original Godot 4 character-creation pipeline for Lum, Urd, Belldandy, and Skuld.

translation.BodySlide: named morph sliders plus preset serialization
translation.OutfitStudio: outfit conform, weight transfer, clipping repair, and deformation audit
translation.BodyGen: runtime or spawn-time application of morph presets
translation.CBBEAndBodyFamilies: shared base architecture with distinct character presets rather than unrelated meshes
translation.3BBBAndCBPLineage: secondary motion is a separate bounded simulation layer, not baked into body-shape sliders
translation.ConversionReferences: explicit body-family conversion maps with rollback-safe source preservation
translation.NexusPresetCulture: many silhouettes can be represented as presets instead of duplicate master meshes

pirateDaddiesMutation.base: original goddess-compatible base topology and skeleton conventions
pirateDaddiesMutation.outfits: conform from original authored garments to character preset while preserving costume identity
pirateDaddiesMutation.motion: Godot SpringBoneSimulator3D first for bounded secondary motion
pirateDaddiesMutation.runtime: Godot 4.7 GLB import, character preset application, animation and physics smoke

rightsFirewall: Reference the mechanics and open-source code where licensing permits. Re-author all Pirate Daddies bodies, faces, costumes, textures, and runtime assets as original work.
